1: // Pixel Runner – simple endless runner
2: // Targets a canvas with id="game"
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) {
7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
8:     return;
9:   }
10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
11:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth;
12:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight;
13: 
14:   // Game constants
15:   const GRAVITY = 0.6;
16:   const JUMP_VELOCITY = -12;
17:   const PLAYER_SIZE = 20;
18:   const SCROLL_SPEED = 4;
19:   const OBSTACLE_SPACING = 200; // distance between obstacles
20: 
21:   // State
22:   let playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
23:   let playerVy = 0;
24:   let isJumping = false;
25:   let offsetX = 0;
26:   let obstacles = []; // {x, type: 'gap'|'spike'}
27:   let lastObstacleX = width;
28:   let score = 0;
29:   let gameOver = false;
30: 
31:   // Input
32:   const jump = () => {
33:     if (playerY >= height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
34:       playerVy = JUMP_VELOCITY;
35:     }
36:   };
37:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.code === 'Space' || e.key === ' ') jump(); });
38:   canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown', jump);
39: 
40:   // Helper to spawn obstacles
41:   const addObstacle = () => {
42:     const type = Math.random() < 0.7 ? 'gap' : 'spike';
43:     obstacles.push({ x: lastObstacleX + OBSTACLE_SPACING, type });
44:     lastObstacleX += OBSTACLE_SPACING;
45:   };
46:   // Fill initial obstacles
47:   for (let i = 0; i < Math.ceil(width / OBSTACLE_SPACING) + 2; i++) addObstacle();
48: 
49:   const update = () => {
50:     if (gameOver) return;
51:     // Player physics
52:     playerVy += GRAVITY;
53:     playerY += playerVy;
54:     if (playerY > height - PLAYER_SIZE) {
55:       playerY = height - PLAYER_SIZE;
56:       playerVy = 0;
57:     }
58: 
59:     // Move obstacles
60:     obstacles.forEach(o => o.x -= SCROLL_SPEED);
61:     // Remove off‑screen and add new ones
62:     if (obstacles[0].x < -40) {
63:       obstacles.shift();
64:       addObstacle();
65:       score++;
66:     }
67: 
68:     // Collision detection
69:     const playerRect = { x: 40, y: playerY, w: PLAYER_SIZE, h: PLAYER_SIZE };
70:     for (const o of obstacles) {
71:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
72:         // gap is a hole in the ground; if player is over it and on ground, lose
73:         const gapStart = o.x;
74:         const gapEnd = o.x + 40; // gap width
75:         if (playerRect.x + playerRect.w > gapStart && playerRect.x < gapEnd && playerY + PLAYER_SIZE >= height) {
76:           gameOver = true;
77:         }
78:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
79:         // spike is a triangle from the ground up
80:         const spikeX = o.x;
81:         const spikeWidth = 20;
82:         if (playerRect.x + playerRect.w > spikeX && playerRect.x < spikeX + spikeWidth) {
83:           // simple point-in-rectangle check for top of spike
84:           const spikeTopY = height - 30; // height of spike
85:           if (playerY + PLAYER_SIZE > spikeTopY) {
86:             gameOver = true;
87:           }
88:         }
89:       }
90:     }
91:   };
92: 
93:   const draw = () => {
94:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
95: 
96:     // ground
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';
98:     ctx.fillRect(0, height - 10, width, 10);
99: 
100:     // player
101:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
102:     ctx.fillRect(40, playerY, PLAYER_SIZE, PLAYER_SIZE);
103: 
104:     // obstacles
105:     obstacles.forEach(o => {
106:       if (o.type === 'gap') {
107:         // draw nothing (hole), optionally draw marker
108:         ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
109:         ctx.fillRect(o.x, height - 10, 40, 10);
110:       } else if (o.type === 'spike') {
111:         ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
112:         ctx.beginPath();
113:         ctx.moveTo(o.x, height - 10);
114:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + 10, height - 30);
115:         ctx.lineTo(o.x + 20, height - 10);
116:         ctx.closePath();
117:         ctx.fill();
118:       }
119:     });
120: 
121:     // score
122:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
123:     ctx.font = '16px monospace';
124:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
125: 
126:     if (gameOver) {
127:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
128:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
129:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
130:       ctx.font = '24px monospace';
131:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2 - 60, height / 2);
132:     }
133:   };
134: 
135:   const loop = () => {
136:     update();
137:     draw();
138:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
139:   };
140: 
141:   // start
142:   loop();
143: })();
